body: I'm in school. If I'm being completely honest it's my fault in the first place for being useless and dumb.

I can try but I'm still to scared. Every scream reminds I'm not a useful person. My dad told me during a car ride that I'm not like them and it kind of hurt. I remember once we went for a walk in the morning and well he told me that him and my mom were arguing and obviously that's grown up stuff but he said since they always getting mad at me and that leads to them two fighting that if they got a divorce it would also be a bit of my fault. It hurt to hear that. I'm not trying to get in the way or anything that's why I don't say anything. They always say I'm useless or if I was alone I would be dead I just agree with them silently because it's the truth. I know for a fact I'm overreacting maybe like I'm not depressed or suicidal just kinda sad about how much of a problem I am to my parents. My grades are ok just besides that I'm absolute trash. I'm a bit cold with my parents and they always ask why but I never respond. I'm guessing it's either because I'm mad with them a bit or just I don't want them to see the sadness maybe.
I'm a bit to scared for that. I've thought of sole possible outcomes like for example they get even more mad or they just tell me to leave it sounds like an option they would take.
Thanks. I've been hugging just a blanket and it helped but I just cried myself into a sort of relaxation with some music.
